intro: Part 3: a transport proposal. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: A text about climate can combine measurements, forecasts and recommendations. Identify the source and the degree of certainty; an observed effect does not by itself prove a single cause.
